top_story.headline: Nancy Pelosi Reports Up to $1 Million Stake in San Francisco Office-Building LLC
top_story.dek: A spouse-owned investment in a private LLC was the largest single transaction in today's disclosures.
paragraphs: Rep. Nancy Pelosi's periodic transaction report, filed October 2, lists a $500,001–$1,000,000 purchase on September 8 in REOF XXX, LLC, which the filing says is acquiring and managing a commercial office property at 225 Bush Street in San Francisco. The filing marks the owner as spouse.

Separately, Rep. Michael Rulli reported three trades of $1,001–$15,000 each in Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., Microsoft Corporation and Wells Fargo & Company. Beyond that, the day's FARA, LDA and Office of Government Ethics activity was routine.

sections.headline: Eight Routine Ethics Filings Filed
paragraphs: Department of State and White House officials filed eight ethics disclosures and transaction reports today. All filings are pending final OGE disposition.

sections.headline: No New or Terminated FARA Registrants
paragraphs: The Justice Department's FARA e-file reports showed no new or terminated registrants between October 4 and October 5, 2026.

sections.headline: Pelosi Reports $500,001–$1 Million Office-Building LLC Investment; Rulli Discloses Three Stock Trades
paragraphs: The Clerk of the House logged five new House filings since October 2: two periodic transaction reports and three new candidate reports. Both transaction reports were read in full. The Senate electronic filing system returned no filings for the same window.

items: Rep. Nancy Pelosi (D-CA11) filed a periodic transaction report on 10/02/2026 listing one purchase: a spouse-owned $500,001–$1,000,000 investment on 09/08/2026 in REOF XXX, LLC, a private vehicle that the filing says is acquiring and managing a commercial office property at 225 Bush Street in San Francisco. It is not a publicly traded stock, so there is no ticker to tabulate.
Rep. Michael Rulli (R-OH06) filed a periodic transaction report on 10/02/2026 listing three stock trades in a Merrill Lynch SIMPLE Managed Account, all in the $1,001–$15,000 range:

sections.headline: No New Lobbying Registrations; Third-Quarter Reports Dominate
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database posted 263 filings since October 4, none of them new registrations. They are almost entirely routine third-quarter reports (204 with activity, 42 reporting no activity), plus 12 amendments and 7 terminations. Nothing stood out as tied to a bill or member covered in today's other sections.
